description: Save how QualiLoop reaches the agent, and where it reads traces. mode: endpoint (the default when base_url is given), dify (the app's Dify preset: Dify's chat address unless base_url names a self-hosted one, its request body, the API key as auth header Authorization), async_session (a session endpoint: async_session holds the protocol, with operations init and send), browser (QualiLoop types into the chat page: browser.chat_page_url and browser.input_selector), elevenlabs (elevenlabs.api_key and agent_id; QualiLoop reads the agent's prompt and success criteria) or gohighlevel (gohighlevel.private_token and location_id). Only the endpoint mode reads a trace source. Never put a secret in the arguments: give auth_header_name and auth_header_env for the header, and <field>_env in a block for its secret (elevenlabs.api_key_env, gohighlevel.private_token_env, browser.browserbase_context_id_env, observability.secret_key_env, observability.api_key_env), the variable holding it, read here from the environment or env_file. system_prompt and grounding_documentation (async_session and browser, which carry no trace) become the project's Connection settings sources. The other fields are those of PUT /v1/setup/target in the skill. Fields left out keep what is saved; with no mode and no base_url the saved connection's settings change.

async_session.description: async_session mode: the session protocol, with operations init and send.

auth_header_env.description: The variable holding the header value, such as QUALILOOP_AGENT_SECRET.

auth_header_prefix.description: Put before the value, such as "Bearer ".

base_url.description: The full address of the endpoint, reachable from the internet.

browser.description: browser mode: chat_page_url, input_selector, send_button_selector, submit_method (auto, enter_key, button), wait_timeout_seconds (5 to 300), browserbase_context_id_env.

elevenlabs.description: elevenlabs mode: api_key_env, agent_id, region (global, us, eu, in, sg), default_voice_id, max_reply_ms (0 turns the slow reply check off). Giving agent_id again reads the agent afresh.

env_file.description: Where to read a variable when the environment lacks it.

gohighlevel.description: gohighlevel mode: private_token_env, location_id, channel (Live_Chat, WhatsApp, SMS, Instagram, Facebook), agent_id, reply_timeout_seconds (10 to 300), poll_interval_seconds (1 to 30), observability_enabled.

grounding_documentation.description: async_session and browser modes: the documents the agent answers from.

name.description: The agent's name, as the connection settings show it.

observability.description: Endpoint mode only. Where traces are read: provider otel (QualiLoop tracing, the default), langfuse (host, public_key, secret_key_env), langsmith (api_key_env, host, project) or none (no traces); session_id_path optional.

system_prompt.description: async_session and browser modes: the agent's system prompt, verbatim.

name: connect_save_target
